option_relations.rationale: Malignant myopericytoma is a distinct diagnosis from Angiosarcoma, scalp. While both are vascular tumors, they have different histopathological features and classifications.
Glomus tumor is a benign tumor of glomus cells, which are specialized smooth muscle cells. It is distinct from Angiosarcoma, scalp, which is a malignant vascular tumor.

Myoepithelial carcinoma is a malignant tumor of myoepithelial cells, typically found in salivary glands or soft tissue. It is unrelated to Angiosarcoma, scalp, which is a malignant vascular tumor of the skin.
Atypical Myopericytoma is a variant of myopericytoma, a perivascular tumor. It is distinct from Angiosarcoma, scalp, which is a malignant tumor of endothelial cells.
